title: Randomized, Double-blind Study Comparing Tremelimumab to Placebo in Subjects with Unresectable Malignant Mesothelioma
official: A Phase 2b, Randomized, Double-blind Study Comparing Tremelimumab to Placebo in Second- or Third-line Treatment of Subjects with Unresectable Pleural or Peritoneal Malignant Mesothelioma
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to compare the overall survival (OS) between the 2 treatment arms (tremelimumab and placebo) in subjects with unresectable malignant mesothelioma.
conditions: unresectable pleural or peritoneal malignant mesothelioma

sites.f: Centro Di Riferimento Oncologico Di Aviano – Dipartimento di Oncologia Medica A
